name: B10-0368/2025 (The Left) – Situation in Colombia after the wave of recent terrorist attacks
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the situation in Colombia after the wave of recent terrorist attacks
part_text:
The European Parliament condemns recent attacks in Colombia, including a car bomb in Cali and the killing of Senator Miguel Uribe Turbay. It calls for respect for international humanitarian law and for talks with armed groups. It asks the European Union to keep supporting Colombia's 2016 peace agreement and to fund civil society groups. It also asks the European Commission to take Colombia off its proposed list of safe countries of origin. This is a statement of the Parliament's position; it does not change any law by itself.

- The Parliament states its position and calls for EU support for Colombia's peace process.
- It affects the EU Commission, EU member states, and the Colombian government.
- Next, the resolution is sent to the Council, Commission and other bodies; no binding action follows.
